source: Magic Mountain 2026 trail map (skimap.org map 44134), read by hand
note: Trick and Upper Wizard carry a black diamond on a blue sign and are stored as blue-black. Abracadabra and Rabbit Run are in the learning area at the base.
lifts_source: Magic Mountain snow report (www.magicmtn.com/snow-report), the 'Lifts' table: five lifts, names as printed without the elevation or length after each, fetched 2026-11-23; the tubing park tow is not on it

lifts_explained.Black Summit Quad: the map's Black Line Quad (fixed-grip quad, base to summit; it replaced the old Black Chair)
lifts_explained.Abracadabra Area Tow: the map's Terrain Park Tow (handle tow in the Abracadabra area, where the snow report puts the terrain park; 600 ft on the report, 183 m on our map)
lifts_explained.Learn-to-Ski Lift: the map's Learning Center conveyor (100 ft on the report)
